description: This file declares the interface and factory class for MediaKeysCapabilities within the Rialto media client. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies related to media key capabilities support.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing singleton instances of IMediaKeysCapabilities.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implementation of IMediaKeysCapabilities that provides media key support functionalities.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory::getMediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the IMediaKeysCapabilities instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supported media key systems.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Gets the version of a supported key system.
